name: Poster Rotator
description: Fill a local poster pool per movie from providers, then periodically rotate the Primary Poster image from the pool. This keeps Jellyfin looking fresh with rotating poster images on an interval of your choosing.

versions.changelog: Release 1.8.4.5: Uncapped download budget when MaxDownloadsPerRun=0 with empty-pool priority, all providers enabled for diversity, perceptual difference hash (dHash) for duplicate detection, and slide-in drawer detail panel.
